description: This file defines the SearchModules class within the SuiteCRM project, responsible for managing search modules, including retrieving enabled/disabled modules, caching module definitions, and saving search settings.

classes.name: SearchModules
classes.description: Class responsible for managing search modules, including retrieving, caching, and saving search module configurations.

methods.name: getModulesList
methods.description: Returns a list of all search modules with their labels.

methods.name: getEnabledModules
methods.description: Returns a list of enabled search modules.

methods.name: saveGlobalSearchSettings
methods.description: Saves the administrator's selected search modules to a display configuration file.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModulesDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the display configuration for search modules, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModules
methods.description: Returns module definitions with search fields, building cache if needed.

methods.name: writeUnifiedSearchModulesDisplayFile
methods.description: Writes the search modules display configuration to a PHP file.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds and caches the list of modules supporting unified search.

methods.name: getAllModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules used for global search, including enabled and disabled.
